title: Even Canvas Window Gaps In Mode
description: Fix doubled gap between adjacent windows in the Mode canvas layout. Spacing between windows should match outer canvas inset, including when two window stacks approach each other horizontally.
summary: Fixed doubled gutter between adjacent Mode window stacks: canvas inset now lives only on mode-body (p-single), resizable panels no longer add per-side padding, and horizontal splitters remain the single w-single gutter between neighbors. Added regression test for one canvas inset and one inter-stack gutter; fixed multi-tab chrome column test to query grid slots instead of contents tabbar children.
